blocks.text: Shields, armor and hull: what each layer stops and how it recovers.
Damage drains shields, then armor, then hull.
Armor never comes back on its own: only a Repair Tender restores it.
Hull doesn't regenerate either (research or faction bonuses can add that); a Repair Tender heals it, hull first, then armor.
Spread fire lets unhit ships recover; focused fire keeps their shields down.
Research can raise every layer, and add screens that cut a share of each hit: see Research > Protection.
